reviewerReplyLanes.note: Scope, non-goals, issue wave, and next release decision need go, hold, defer, or no-go.
Repo privacy, branch posture, check names, protected environment, and branch-protection timing need confirmation.
Route shell, migrations, command output, seed path, and unresolved implementation holds need response.
Tenant guard, no-secret proof, no-workbook proof, no-commercial-leak proof, and denial audit evidence need signoff.
Fixture boundary, import dry-run, quarantine, duplicate handling, rollback, and reconciliation need response.
Evidence index, screenshots, transcripts, PR notes, issue links, and closeout ledger need review state.
Test-mode billing boundary, no invoice, no payment key, and no commercial export need confirmation.
Attendance, decision log, action register, parked questions, and management summary need publishing status.

replyStateBoard.label: Approved
replyStateBoard.note: Reviewer lane is approved with evidence, issue trace, no-leak proof, rollback note, and next owner.

replyStateBoard.label: Commented
replyStateBoard.note: Neutral comment exists but does not approve merge; record thread URL and follow-up status.

replyStateBoard.label: Held
replyStateBoard.note: Direction is acceptable but missing proof, owner, target date, or next command is still open.

replyStateBoard.label: Requested changes
replyStateBoard.note: Trust, privacy, test, tenant, audit, branch, or rollback evidence failed.

replyStateBoard.label: Deferred proof
replyStateBoard.note: Proof is intentionally moved forward with owner, reason, target date, and next evidence action.

replyStateBoard.label: Blocked
replyStateBoard.note: Public repo, secret, workbook, commercial leakage, missing rollback, or direct-main risk blocks closeout.

replyStateBoard.label: No response
replyStateBoard.note: Reviewer lane has not replied; meeting scribe or owner must chase before closeout.

replyStateBoard.label: Merge-ready
replyStateBoard.note: All lanes are green, required checks are exact, no-leak is repeated, rollback is visible, and next owner is named.

requestedChangesResolver.note: Remove value, invoice, LOA, agreement, billing, and negotiation content; record no-leak proof.
Rotate credential, remove secret, attach proof, and update rollback note.
Add or prove tenant isolation middleware and denied audit event.
Run workflow, capture exact check names, then update branch protection.
Attach command output for install, lint, test, migration, seed, smoke, and audit.
Write branch, PR, repo recreation, credential rotation, and data path reset instructions.

replySlaCadence.note: Record any approve, comment, hold, request changes, defer, no-response, or blocker before the session ends.
Ping reviewer lane owners that have no response or vague approval.
Attach proof, update owner, or convert hold to request changes or defer.
Repeat no workbook, no secret, no billing, no invoice, and no commercial export.
Bring unresolved reply rows into Command Center and Reports.
v144 or v145 can print closeout and minutes once real replies exist.

managementReplyBrief.label: Approval rule
managementReplyBrief.text: Approval is valid only with evidence, issue trace, no-leak proof, rollback note, and next owner.

managementReplyBrief.label: Hold rule
managementReplyBrief.text: Hold remains acceptable only with missing proof, owner, date, and next command.

managementReplyBrief.label: Request-changes rule

managementReplyBrief.label: No-response rule
managementReplyBrief.text: No response is a management action, not silence; owner must chase or defer.

managementReplyBrief.label: Next build
managementReplyBrief.text: Reply capture becomes the evidence source for exportable closeout and meeting minutes.

handoff: v143 turns the backend repo day meeting pack into a reply capture board.
The board separates approved, commented, held, requested-changes, deferred, blocked, no-response, and merge-ready states.
The static demo still cannot read GitHub replies; it now defines exactly how the real replies should be recorded after the private repo meeting.
v144 can now prepare an evidence closeout PDF/export plan, while v145 can generate backend meeting minutes from captured replies.
